summary: Frontend-only verification of Roadman Pigeon's 3 one-time scripted speech lines. Unlocked all premium pigeons via 1337 leet easter egg (localStorage dp_leetUnlock=1). Enabled Easy Mode + auto-fly (JS-based altitude-controlled Space dispatch) to reliably survive past 100m and beyond. All 3 lines fired exactly once at the correct thresholds, in a properly clamped bubble, with correct suppression/priority over ordinary HIC/quips, correct revive behaviour, correct per-run reset, and zero leakage to other pigeons.
verified_behaviours: READY screen (Roadman, before first tap): NO 'Wargwarn?' bubble present (roadman-script-bubble absent). Confirmed via DOM query.
First flap: 'Wargwarn?' appears in speech bubble anchored to pigeon at distance ~1m. testID roadman-script-text = 'Wargwarn?'.
50m milestone: 'I said wargwarn fam?' appears once at distance=49m (first frame after crossing 50m).
100m milestone: "A'ight say less, deekhed" appears once at distance=99m.

Each of the 3 lines displays for ~2.2s then disappears; polling confirmed each line is fired only ONCE per run (subsequent captures within the visible window are the same event, no re-fire after the bubble hides).

Revive test: crashed at 439m (after all 3 lines already fired), clicked REVIVE, continued the SAME run — none of the 3 lines re-triggered post-revive. postReviveWargwarn=false, post50AfterRevive=false, post100AfterRevive=false.
New run reset: Across 5 fresh runs (Play Again -> new run) with Roadman selected, 'Wargwarn?' fired again on each brand-new run's first flap (verified in the multi-run smoke test).

Other-pigeon test (Classic): flew for 35s / max 308m — roadman-script-bubble NEVER appeared. Classic's ordinary 'HIC!' quip appeared normally (visible in screenshot). Confirms only pigeon.id==='roadman' triggers the scripted lines.
Ordinary Roadman dialogue BEFORE first flap: on READY screen for 8s, saw 'SAFE.' and "I'M GOOD." quips render normally — so ordinary dialogue is not permanently disabled.

No visual overlap during scripted line: while polling on Roadman runs during scripted bubble visibility windows, no ordinary HIC/quip text was seen overlapping the scripted bubble (suppressQuips gating in DrunkPigeon works).

Bubble containment at iPhone SE (375x667): scripted bubble rect = {left:17, right:193, top:134, bottom:165} — fully inside 375x667 viewport (no clipping top/bottom/left/right). Verified via getBoundingClientRect.
Bubble containment at Dynamic Island 393x852: bubble rendered fully on-screen in screenshot 04_first_flap.png — top ~140px, well below the 44px Dynamic Island safe-area.
critical_code_review_comments: GameScreen.js loop trigger uses `else if` for 50m/100m thresholds (line 271). Order-wise this is fine because 50m fires first and then the next frame handles 100m, but if distance jumps >50m in a single frame (e.g. after a lag spike) the 100m line could be delayed one frame. Non-blocking.

showScriptedLine has a 2200ms fixed timeout; if two triggers fire within 2.2s (theoretical: distance jumps 50-100m fast) the second call clears the timer and replaces text — the first line would be cut short. Not observed in practice but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: localStorage init: dp_leetUnlock=1 (all premium pigeons usable via leet), dp_easyOwned=1 (Easy Mode entitlement for larger gap), dp_selectedPigeon=roadman|classic, dp_selectedMap=easy.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reach 50m/100m in this flappy engine, key-press 'Space' at fixed intervals dies at ~15m (first obstacle). Use altitude-controlled auto-fly: in page.evaluate, poll [data-testid='game-pigeon'] bounding rect and dispatch keydown Space only when pigeon Y > target (window.innerHeight*0.42) with a >=80ms cooldown. This survives indefinitely on Easy Mode.
rca of the issue: No bug — feature works as specified.
